_what: Redesign phase 9, task 1 (notes/plans/P9-directories-search-timeline.md). Per person: roles from the closed list of schema/vocab.json personFacets, vitalStatus, roleStatus and underOath, each derived from the person's OWN record on this board (narrative, claims, affiliations, chronology, conflicts, unverified, edges), never from outside knowledge; `unknown` where the record is silent. `basis` quotes the words of the record each value rests on. A first pass by Sonnet batches proposed every row; an Opus reviewer checked every dead, every claimant, every underOath yes, every person whose authored status says dead, and a 10% sample, and its verdict is what is written (`reviewed`). The authored `status` field is untouched.

_rules.claimant: asserts as fact, on their own authority or relaying others, something about the alleged programme or phenomenon (recovered craft, reverse engineering, non-human bodies, hidden programmes, contact, or a specific concealment of these) that the record does not show confirmed by a primary document; officials who investigate, deny or call for disclosure are not
_rules.witness: gives a first-hand account: says they personally saw, handled, were present at or worked on the thing
_rules.vitalStatus: dead where the record states a death or its authored status is dead with nothing later; alive where it records an act dated 2020 or later and no death; otherwise unknown
_rules.roleStatus: about the post that puts the person on the board; a dead person is never current
_rules.underOath: yes where the record says sworn testimony, a sworn statement, an affidavit or a deposition; no where it says they did not testify or were not sworn; otherwise unknown
_rules.unverifiedRoles: a role the record itself calls unverified (no service record produced) is left out
